notes.title: v1.30 - Two bug fixes and one extra option
notes.content:
Minor bug fixes:
[list]
[*]Skills that "always hit" like Eternity Rising, Bulls-eye, and Ajna can now hit Ranged-Only enemies.
[*]Fixed rare bug that caused the beginning of a scene near the end of the game to start with a black screen for several seconds.
[*]Added option to the System menu to increase damage taken: 1x - 10x

notes.title: v1.29 - Change Log
notes.content:

(NOTE - v1.29b was released on 2021_11_01 with a bug fix for the Slant Cave ladder)

[olist]
[*]Added text fast-forwarding. Hold shift on the keyboard to speed through message text.
(square on PS controller or X on X-Box controller)

notes.title: v1.20 - Change Log
notes.content:
v1.20 has been released with the following changes:
[olist]
[*]Fixed crash when Asera equips the Throg Shard or any other one with TP skills.
[*]Throg no longer shows an empty MP bar when equipping a Shard with MP moves. Asera no longer shows an empty TP bar when equipping a Shard with TP moves.
[*]Throg's status effect skills (Venom, Melatonin, Madness, Possess, Delusion) now hit an area and chances of status are increased from 75% to 80%
[*]All of the Wraiths' physical attacks were being absorbed by the Bell accessories
[*]Fixed Earth Wraith's 50% threshold buff which was using too much stamina
[*]Xero's Replenish skill cooldown changed from 3 to 1
[*]Bacillus now has the "Flying" break type so it can be hit by Turbulence and Wing Breaker
[*]Can now call the airship from the top of Mt Saratai so you don't have to walk back down
[*]Added icon for the "Charge Backfire" status in the Flash Golem battles
[*]Fixed stairs in Burns' sidequest that warped to the wrong tile
[*]Fixed two Roamers at Damri Mountain that couldn't be radiated
[*]Stadium Sewer Angst starts with a bit less stamina and can be blinded
[/olist]

v1.20.1 has been released to fix the following bug:
[list]
[*]Fixed problem with the F12 disable script causing a crash. Some computers may now no longer disable F12. If you are one of these rare cases, do not hit F12 while playing or it will cause all sorts of weirdness.
[/list]

v1.20.2 has been released to fix the following bug:
[olist]
[*]Fixed Flash Bombs when using WASD
[*]Followers weren't turned back on after Water Wraith fight
[*]Enda's Antitoxin and Clarify skills now use only 800 stamina
[*]Cross Sash agility boost lowered from 15% to 10%
[/olist]

notes.title: v1.19 - Change Log
notes.content:
v1.19 has been released with the following changes:
[olist]
[*]Added "Sinkliner" device for Asera. Can be crafted in Simple Devices book. "Time Drops" are now dropped by cherrystones, scorched ice, nimbus, and cloud urchins. They are used to craft the device.
It damages enemies in a straight line with water and pulls them toward the center horizontal line of battle.
[*]Added Time Drops treasure in Jedire Grotto and Saltwater Tunnel
[*]Echo Pin now has +20 def/mdef and doubles EXP rate
[*]Added small amounts of DEF to various accessories.
[*]Fixed bug in Kail boss battles where sometimes he wouldn't die at 0% hp until being attacked again
[*]Fixed bug in Kail battles where enemies wouldn't die if their counterattack missed. Also added puff of smoke to enemy deaths.
[*]Refuge enemy now weak to Shell Breaker and Fin Breaker
[*]Earth 2 MP cost changed from 38 to 32
[*]Fixed bug with Slash's Tremor skill that caused it to ignore resistances
[*]Raised Tremor damage from 50% to 75%, slightly increased the radius, and reduced cooldown from 3 to 2.
[*]Raised damage of Slash's Extinguish skills and doubled the DEF buffs if an enemy is defeated
[*]Fixed graphical error when skipping a scene during a battle near the end of the game
[*]Fixed graphical bug in Xero's internal scene near the end of the game that occurs if you've been skipping scenes
[*]Heyama Katana shop now allows you to sell
[*]Changed "Press ENTER" text in Bestiary to say "A" or "B" when an XBox controller is connected
[*]Added various tidbits of summon skill lore around the world. (Soldier in Glarefrost, old man in Heyama Shard shop, woman in Atlantia Shard shop, book in Brantle Lab)
[*]Mend Amulet now recovers HP/MP after battle on Hard Mode too
[*]Fixed bug where Final Tenjin could use Neutron Star Omega at the wrong time
[/olist]

notes.title: v1.18 - Change Log
notes.content:
v1.18 has been released with the following changes:
[olist]
[*]Fixed bug with moving panels in funal dungeon that could cause a panel to get stuck
[*]All battles with enemies that can only be damaged by ranged attacks are now escapable. In rare circumstances you could get stuck in battle with no way to win.
[*]Fixed damage calculations for Eternal Courage, Gasuto No Jinsei, and Bass. They were dealing double damage on normal attacks.
[*]Doubled rate at which Eternal Courage gains power. It is now 1 attack to add 1 damage. (Your previous gains are automatically adjusted)
[*]Re-sorted several skills that were out of place. Now Charge/Magic Charge/Prism Links will always be at the top as well as other important skills
[*]Throg's "At Arms" skill reduced from 30TP to 20TP.
[*]Asera can now learn Fire 2 and Fire 3
[*]Xero's Echo skill damage was not being reset after battle.
[*]Fixed bug where Fight/Escape menu wouldn't open during Surprise attacks
[*]Changed one line of Xero's dialogue at the beginning to more accurately describe Domes
[*]Music faded out too early during one scene in Glarefrost
[*]Fixed minor visual bug in that same scene
[*]Fixed Scourge (part 2) resistance to ice to match Part 1
[*]Updated controls images for X-Box controllers at beginning and in training area
[*]Fixed multiple enemy skills that were giving Fire "Last Hit" states when they shouldn't have been.
[/olist]

notes.title: v1.17 - Change Log
notes.content:
v1.17 has been released with the following changes:
[olist]
[*]Made the Prism Link inputs stay still. Also the buttons get erased as you hit them. The motion can be turned back on from the System menu.
[*]Changed command entry scenes and treasures so entered commands are erased and the keys don't raise upwards
[*]Added an XBox controller A/B Swap option to the System menu
[*]System settings now get copied over to New Game +
[*]Fixed issue where if you started a New Game+ early then several characters could miss earning their starting EXP/PP when they join or rejoin.
[*]HP Percentage based moves on Hard Mode were dealing extra damage to the player.
[*]Asera's elemental guard skills MP reduced from 8 to 5. Also now they only use 800 stamina instead of 1000.
[*]Final Tenjin's Neutron Star Omega was Dark element instead of non-elemental
[*]Limit range of Werewolf monster in future scene so he can't block the climbing tile
[*]Monsters in Stained Forest in area before boss can now be avoided
[*]Disable pre-emptive/surprise attacks on the first ghost battle in Arnoa
[*]Reduced shaking in boss map of Arnoa. Shakng is off completely in Easy mode.
[/olist]

v1.17.1 has been released with the following changes:
[olist]
[*]Fixed barrel puzzles in Palisade Prison. They couldn't be picked up when using an XBox controller.
[/olist]

notes.title: v0.8 Change Log
notes.content:
v0.8 has been released with the following changes:

[olist]
[*]Boy in Blue Creek who throws a rock could make the game freeze.
[*]F12 was causing a crash. The key has now been disabled.
[*]You can now enable Alt-Tab, Alt-F4, Alt-Enter from the "Game.ini" file next to the executable. It is disabled by default because Alt-Enter causes screen stretching problems. To enable them set DisableAltKey=0
[*]Party followers weren't turned on at the very beginning of the game. Slash and Kina aren't following you until after the first explosion.
[*]Some enemies that weren't supposed to be able to move in battle could get knocked around by certain skills like Asera's Shadow Mine.
[*]Quetzel book in Simon's House said enemy #129, but it's really #140. Terra/Storm Beasts in Signey Cay were also labeled wrong.
[*]Lower Flapper HP to 120. Firebugs are now weak to lightning.
[*]Change up Xero's and Slash's victory quotes a bit.
[/olist]
